findings.body: Copy-paste slip: the template interpolates `${min}` twice, so the message never reports the upper bound — `assertInRange(7, 1, 5)` throws "7 is outside 1..1".
findings.suggestedFix: Interpolate the second bound: `` `${value} is outside ${min}..${max}` ``.

findings.body: The catch block discards the caught error: `err` is never rethrown or attached as a cause, so the original RangeError bounds detail is dropped and callers cannot tell why the port was rejected.
findings.suggestedFix: Attach it: `throw new RangeError(`invalid port: ${raw}`, { cause: err })`.

testFlags.note: No test asserts on the error text or the preserved cause (inferred, not measured).

evidence: src/lib/range.ts: the new bounds message interpolates the lower bound twice, so it never reports the upper one.
